messages:
Sam (CSM): Heads-up: Citrine Labs flagged a multi-team ramp. New teams: Conversation UX, Catalog Enrichment, Risk Ops. They want embeddings + low-latency realtime answers. Rough lift: current qps ~12 -> projected ~60 in 6 weeks. :eyes:
Dario (AE): Nice expansion. Renewal in 3 months so this is high-leverage. Do they care about isolation (private vs dedicated)? Could affect T&C.
Sam (CSM): They asked for tenant isolation for Risk Ops and Catalog Enrichment. Conversation UX can be on shared hosted if latency is met.
Ivy (SolutionsEng): Which models and latency targets? We need that to decide batching/caching.
Sam (CSM): They're prototyping with 13B decoders for convo and a smaller embedder. Target: p90 <200ms for 64-128 token responses; embeddings within 50ms.
Rina (Onboarding Eng): For p90 <200ms we should propose a dedicated small pool with prewarmed KV and a burst policy. I'll sketch two configs (cost-optimized vs perf-optimized).
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-4021: "Citrine Labs expansion - dedicated pilot request" assigned to Rina.
Ivy (SolutionsEng): Also request sample query mix and typical context window. If many concurrent short chats, batching will hurt latency; recommend prefix caching and per-tenant cache TTLs. Example policy suggestion:
```
route_policy:
  - name: citrine-riskops
    model_family: decoder-13b
    preference: dedicated_low_latency
    batching: minimal
    caching: prefix_kv:true
    isolation: tenant_isolated:true
    autoscale_min: 1
    autoscale_max: 6
```
Dario (AE): I'll prepare a renewal upsell outline showing ARPA lift and options (committed nodes vs usage overage). Sam, can you collect their expected timeline and exec sponsor?
Sam (CSM): Will do. They said pilot in 2 weeks, full ramp in 6. Exec sponsor is CTO (via intro). Scheduling workshop w/ them next Wed to capture prompts and SLIs.
Rina (Onboarding Eng): Action items: (1) I'll open pilot sizing PR and request infra signoff (CS-4021) 10/2. (2) Ivy to prepare routing + cache playbook. (3) Sam to run workshop and capture canonical prompts + renewal notes.
Sam (CSM): Thanks. I'll post the workshop invite and add the sample payloads here. :thumbsup:
